answer: EigenTrust derives centrality from weighted trust paths, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity discounts unsupported endorsements. Reputation decays exponentially with a temporal half-life, so only sustained honest service can build durable influence. Freshly spawned sybil identities—even those named trellis, wharf, or pigment—start with near-zero eigenvector centrality and, absent trusted reciprocal links, cannot meet consensus thresholds.
